name: Retatrutide

gate.label: Phase 3 readout
gate.basis: 5 open studies in an indication the forecast values, at enrolment x the area's per-patient rate x the share of each run still ahead

high.label: at DiMasi 2016's per-phase level, which includes long-term animal testing and the cost of compounds that fail within the phase; 2013 against 2018 dollars, so the ratio is if anything low

held.note: A miss leaves 5 other Phase 3s open; the model's own rule would hold it at 55%, but the stated PoS governs until it is cleared.

gate.legs_basis: implied, not published: the stated PoS of 87.5% over the 89.4% the asset carries if its Phase 3 readout passes gives gate odds of 97.9%, against 61.0% published; a failure is taken at nil, the model's convention for a failed programme
